phases.name: Auth outcome classification and saved-token recovery
testsFirst: transient validation errors do not mark credentials reconnect-required
expired/invalid access token refreshes with saved refresh token before consent is requested
invalid refresh token or valid identity/scope mismatch requires reconnection
refresh persistence failure blocks activation without leaking token/error
phases.exit: Typed auth outcomes preserve saved credentials on transient failure and only confirmed authorization failure requests reconnect.

phases.name: Non-blocking Twitch integration supervisor
testsFirst: local runtime/server startup completes while Twitch is offline
startup validation/eligibility transient failure schedules a bounded jittered retry
duplicate triggers coalesce and initialization never overlaps
successful recovery installs one listener/adapter and publishes connected only after reconciliation
shutdown cancels retry and prevents late runtime installation
phases.exit: One timer-driven supervisor restores saved integration state without blocking local API startup or opening parallel Twitch clients.

phases.name: EventSub initial failure and true disconnect recovery
testsFirst: initial EventSub connection exhaustion is observable and supervised
actual disconnect followed by ready triggers one reconciliation
Twitch session_reconnect uses SDK handoff without opening another listener or false gap reconciliation
duplicate events overlapping reconciliation remain idempotent
phases.exit: Twurple retains protocol ownership; application state and retries recover correctly after startup exhaustion or true drop.

phases.name: Status projection, local persistence, and documentation
testsFirst: health and setup never expose raw error/token detail
real PostgreSQL outbox intent remains unchanged while Twitch offline and resumes after integration recovery
bilingual documentation/localization contracts cover all new status and recovery behavior
phases.exit: Recovery state is safe and localized; durable PostgreSQL intent survives restart/recovery; English and pt-BR records match.

retryPolicy.notes: Use the repository clock/timer injection patterns. A healthy connection resets the attempt count. No retry timer may survive stop().

constraints: No live Twitch claim without authorized validation
